SignatureProjectShowcase.title: From bare shell to a home that feels finished before you've even moved in.
SignatureProjectShowcase.body1: A full villa fit-out on Palm Jumeirah — joinery, lighting and finishes coordinated end to end so every room reads as one continuous design story, not a series of disconnected decisions.

WhyUs.body: We partner with trusted artisans and premium suppliers so every wall, surface and detail reflects lasting quality — not just an opening-day finish.
WhyUs.point1Body: No templates, no cookie-cutter layouts — every concept is shaped around your lifestyle, taste and how you actually live in the space.
WhyUs.point2Body: We design interiors that age gracefully — refined, elegant spaces that still feel right five and ten years from now.
WhyUs.point3Body: From spatial proportions to the final touch of hardware, every element is crafted with precision so the whole space feels effortless.

Process.title: One coordinated journey, from first call to final walkthrough.
Process.body: No juggling separate contractors, no gaps between design and delivery. One team carries your project through design, approvals, execution and furniture — start to finish, with full accountability at every step.
Process.listenBody: We shape the brief around your vision, with your input welcomed at every stage.
Process.budgetBody: Every schedule, order and delivery is tracked so nothing stalls on site.
Process.designBody: Balanced, functional interiors delivered — and supported long after handover.

Risks.title: Most renovations go wrong in the same predictable ways. Yours won't.
Risks.subtitle: Here's what we watch for on every project — before it ever becomes a problem — and exactly how we prevent it.

scope.title: Unclear project scope
scope.prevention: A signed scope document before any contract is issued — no ambiguity, no scope creep.

measurements.title: Wrong site measurements
measurements.prevention: A laser-verified site survey ahead of every single design drawing.

mep.title: MEP conflicts mid-execution
mep.prevention: MEP drawings cross-checked with design before a single wall is touched.

approvals.title: Approval delays that stall your project
approvals.prevention: Authority submissions handled in-house and tracked end to end.

materials.title: Poor material selection
materials.prevention: Every sample approved on-site before an order is ever placed.

supervision.title: Weak site supervision
supervision.prevention: A dedicated supervisor on-site through every single phase.

AboutStory.titlePlain1: Built to close the gap between
AboutStory.body1: G.A.G Interiors started from a frustration shared by homeowners across the UAE: design studios draw beautiful renders, contractors execute someone else's drawings, and nobody owns the outcome when things fall through the cracks.
AboutStory.body2: So we built one studio that carries a project from the first concept sketch, through authority approvals and on-site renovation, to custom joinery and final handover — with one team accountable at every single stage.
AboutStory.body3: Today that means over 150 homes and commercial spaces across Dubai, Abu Dhabi and the Northern Emirates, each delivered through the same coordinated, no-surprises process.

FounderSpotlight.title: A studio led by one point of accountability, not a committee.
FounderSpotlight.body1: G.A.G Interiors was founded on a simple belief: great interiors come from continuity. The same eye that sketches the first concept should be the one signing off on the final detail of installation. Our founder leads every project personally through design, approvals and execution, working alongside a tight team of architects, engineers and craftsmen who hold that same standard.
FounderSpotlight.body2: With over a decade shaping residential and commercial interiors across the UAE, the focus has never wavered: fewer handoffs, clearer communication, and spaces that feel truly resolved — not just decorated.
